title: ArcCivs 0.1.34: farmer harvests crops without baking
assumptions: Low/base/high: 1/10/16 independent cities with one farmer, 1/2/4 active hours daily, 1/4/16 bakes per minute before removal. Scenario assumptions, not measured telemetry.

All three farm levels: the native baking action consumed 3 wheat and issued 1 bread. Fed action duration is 1500ms, hungry 3000ms; theoretical ceiling 2400/1200 actions per hour, constrained by wheat, travel and durable commits.

New baking jobs are disabled. Existing accepted receipts finish with their original quantities; legacy farm production=BREAD remains loadable and selects wheat harvesting. Native crop drops and growth are unchanged.
No new profession, reward, price, currency or XP flow. Existing bread remains edible and transferable, including bread manually crafted by players.
Existing SELL may monetize physical crops; the future contract-only economy is not assumed active. Wheat versus bread SELL price effects are not measured and no conversion rate is invented.
Prior read-only 168-hour ledger is admin-dominated and does not measure city items. It is not used as an ordinary player-income baseline.
Deleting the recipe reduces automatic transformation only; stacking and alternate accounts cannot re-enable it. No duplicate inputs or outputs on restart. Housing and population limits are unchanged.

flows.basis: Bread produced per completed baking action, not coins.
Wheat consumed by baking only; reduced consumption leaves existing wheat in custody.
